```{r}
#| warnings: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gamlss)

```

```{r}

food <- vroom::vroom("FoodExpenses.txt")

```

```{r}

# make heteroskedastic mdl using gamlss
het_food <- gamlss(formula = EatingOut ~ Income, sigma.formula = ~., data = food)
```

# checking assumptions

```{r}

car::avPlots(lm(EatingOut ~ Income, data = food))

```

```{r}

std_resids <- residuals(het_food, what = "z-scores")
```
